clean_reps.description: Three consecutive clean push-ups with full ROM (elbow <= 95) and proper plank posture.

partial_reps.description: One repetition that fails to reach down threshold (<= 95 deg). Flagged partial_range.

hips_sagging.description: One repetition with sagging hips (hip deviation < -0.15). Flagged hips_sagging.

hips_piked.description: One repetition with piked hips (hip deviation > +0.15). Flagged hips_piked.

too_fast.description: One twitching repetition faster than 0.8s minimum duration. Flagged too_fast.

low_confidence.description: One repetition with mean visibility below 0.6. Flagged low_confidence.

standing_upright.description: User standing upright. Orientation gate blocks push-up counting; 0 reps detected.

frame_exit.description: Person leaves camera frame during lowering. Repetition abandoned; 0 reps detected.
